title: G-Shock G-Steel Solar Men Watch GST-B1000D-1ADR
description:
Tough, innovative, functional beauty — reimagined in sharp, minimalist style.

The GST-B1000D carries on the G-SHOCK heritage of tough construction and design rooted in functional beauty, reconstructing this legacy to achieve a polished, sleek expression.

The bezel goes logo-free for a clean, modern look, while three separate finishes — vertical hairline, circular hairline, and mirror polishing — create a rich and sophisticated textural appeal that changes as light is reflected at different angles. The mirror- and hairline-finished solid stainless-steel band is paired with a tri-fold clasp also crafted from solid stainless steel. This sharp, flat design takes you from business meetings to casual settings to outdoor activities with ease.
features: Analog: 3 hands (hour, minute (hand moves every 10 seconds), second), 2 dials (24-hour, day)
